meta.how_built: Tables fetched live via PostgREST with the app's public key (RLS shows only status='published' rows). Schema/constraints/hidden rows read via SQL and embedded verbatim. Read-only: nothing was inserted or changed.

columns.note: NEVER supply id in INSERT — GENERATED ALWAYS rejects it.
FK -> mtb.topics(id). Use topics where is_chapter=true.
FK -> mtb.content_levels(id). NULL = shared atom shown at every level.
No trigger: NOT auto-updated on UPDATE. Set updated_at = now() yourself in UPDATE statements.
Existing data is inconsistent: 522 rows NULL, 51 rows '{}'. Use '{}'::text[] for new rows.

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX atoms_pkey ON mtb.atoms USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX atoms_one_per_level ON mtb.atoms USING btree (chapter_id, atom_key, COALESCE(level_id, '*'::text))
CREATE INDEX atoms_chapter_level ON mtb.atoms USING btree (chapter_id, level_id, atom_order)

schema.enum_types: none — all 'enums' are text + CHECK constraints (values listed per column)

rls.note: No INSERT/UPDATE policy: the anon/publishable key cannot write. Migrations applied with the service/postgres role (Supabase apply_migration) bypass RLS.

constraints_you_must_respect: Do not put id in the column list (GENERATED ALWAYS).
Required on INSERT (NOT NULL, no default): chapter_id, atom_key, atom_type, body. atom_order defaults to 0 — always set it explicitly.
level_id must be one of content_levels.id or NULL (shared).
Uniqueness is (chapter_id, atom_key, COALESCE(level_id,'*')) and it INCLUDES hidden/archived rows. With ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING a colliding row is silently skipped — always verify counts after insert.

Chapter 410 (civil Strength of Materials) already holds hidden rows with keys som-concept/som-formula/som-example/som-mcq (govt_technical + govt_basic) and som-diagram (shared). Use a different prefix there (e.g. csom-*).

atom_order must be unique per (chapter_id, level_id) in practice (no DB constraint, but the app sorts by atom_order,id and the shared row at order 5 sits next to level rows 1-4). Shared SVG convention: atom_order 5.

Set BOTH status and archived consistently. The app's notes query filters only via RLS (status='published'); a row with archived=true but status='published' WOULD still be shown. To hide: status='hidden', archived=true.
content_hash is not computed by the DB: supply md5(body::text).
updated_at is not auto-updated: set updated_at = now() in UPDATE statements.
difficulty only easy|medium|hard. lang only hi|en|both (all current rows are 'hi').
Never JOIN on topics.slug: 'strength-of-materials' exists for both civil (410) and mechanical (439). Use explicit chapter_id.

app_read_logic.chapter_has_notes_index: atoms?select=chapter_id,level_id  -> per chapter a Set of (level_id || '*')
meaning: Level comes from the selected exam's content_level (SSC JE / RRB JE -> govt_technical, NTPC -> govt_basic).
Shared atoms (level_id NULL) are shown at every level, merged with that level's rows, ordered by atom_order then id.
The app does NOT read exam_tags, class_tags, subject_tag, difficulty or content_hash — they are metadata only.
No atoms for the chapter+level -> the app shows '🔒 इस अध्याय के नोट्स जल्द आएँगे।'

atom_key_pattern.recommended_for_new_rows: Keep '<prefix>-concept', '<prefix>-formula', '<prefix>-example', '<prefix>-mcq' for level rows (same key in govt_technical and govt_basic) and '<prefix>-diagram' for the shared SVG. Make the prefix unique within the chapter and avoid som-* on chapter 410.

body.text: विद्युत धारा आवेश के प्रवाह की दर है, मात्रक ऐम्पियर (A)। प्रतिरोध का मात्रक ओम (Ω) है। बल्ब, पंखा, हीटर घरेलू उपकरण हैं।

body.note: JE में ओम का नियम, श्रेणी/समानांतर संयोजन और kWh अक्सर पूछे जाते हैं।
body.text: ओम का नियम: V = IR (स्थिर ताप पर)। विद्युत शक्ति P = VI = I²R = V²/R। ऊर्जा का व्यावसायिक मात्रक kWh है। श्रेणी में कुल R = R₁+R₂; समानांतर में 1/R = 1/R₁+1/R₂।

insert_template_sql:
with src as (
  select v.chapter_id, v.level_id, v.atom_key, v.atom_type, v.atom_order, v.title, v.body::jsonb as body
  from (values
    (899,'govt_technical','lab-concept','concept',1,'<title>',$j${"text":"…","note":"…"}$j$),
    (899,null,'lab-diagram','svg',5,'<title>',$j${"svg":"<svg viewBox='0 0 300 120' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>…</svg>","caption":"…"}$j$)
  ) as v(chapter_id, level_id, atom_key, atom_type, atom_order, title, body)
)
insert into mtb.atoms (chapter_id, level_id, atom_key, atom_type, atom_order, title, body, lang, status, archived, exam_tags, class_tags, subject_tag, difficulty, content_hash)
select s.chapter_id, s.level_id, s.atom_key, s.atom_type, s.atom_order, s.title, s.body, 'hi', 'published', false,
  case when s.level_id='govt_technical' then array['rrb-je-cbt1','rrb-je-cbt2','ssc-je-paper1']::text[]
       when s.level_id='govt_basic' then array['rrb-ntpc-graduate-cbt-1','rrb-ntpc-graduate-cbt-2','rrb-ntpc-ug-cbt-1','rrb-ntpc-ug-cbt-2']::text[]
       else '{}'::text[] end,
  '{}'::text[], 'general-science', 'medium', md5(s.body::text)
from src s
on conflict do nothing;
-- then verify: select level_id, count(*) from mtb.atoms where chapter_id=899 and status='published' and not archived group by 1;

summary.assumptions: 9 atoms/chapter (4 govt_technical + 4 govt_basic + 1 shared svg) for maths/reasoning/GA/GS; 5 (4 govt_technical + 1 svg) for civil/electrical; GA excludes 416 Current Affairs.
schema_surprises: id is GENERATED ALWAYS (cannot insert explicit ids).
No is_shared column — shared means level_id IS NULL.
No triggers: updated_at and content_hash are never auto-set.
Unique key includes hidden rows (chapter 410 som-* keys are taken).
App ignores exam_tags/subject_tag/difficulty; visibility depends only on chapter_id + level_id + status (RLS).
archived=true alone does NOT hide a row from the app; status must be 'hidden'.
topics has no status column; subjects/topics use name_en/name_hi, not name.
GA section of SSC JE + NTPC includes general-science (so GS atoms reach NTPC students).
insert_pitfalls: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING hides collisions — verify counts
non-chapter duplicate topics (20-26, inbox ids) look like real chapters
jsonb inside dollar quotes: keep SVG attributes in single quotes
